watch._topicsNote: Added 15 Sep. `topics` searches title+abstract across all of cs.*, NOT just cs.HC, because the cs.HC listing is not where these papers live. Solaris ('Towards Interfaces That Are Generated, Not Coded', arXiv 2609.00776) was announced 1 Sep under cs.CV and went unseen for five weeks of daily sweeps — the single most on-topic paper of the period, invisible because of a category.
